customer.business: MUN Prep App (AI preparation workspace for Model UN delegates, India-first, ₹199/week or ₹299/month)
customer.target: Model UN delegates in India, 14 to 22, English-medium, preparing for a specific conference date
customer.where: Online, India (tier-1 and tier-2 cities). Bought by the student, a parent, or the school

segments.name: Club head or coordinator buying for a group

behaviours.name: Already uses ChatGPT for everything
behaviours.how: Has ChatGPT (or Gemini) open on their phone for schoolwork and doesn't see why this is different.

behaviours.name: Prepares the night before
behaviours.how: Does almost nothing until the last evening, then panics and writes it all in one sitting.

behaviours.name: First conference, no idea what to expect
behaviours.how: Has never been in committee, is scared of speaking, and is looking for anything that makes the day survivable.

behaviours.name: Taught by a school MUN coach
behaviours.how: The school runs sessions and gives out templates, so they already have a method and a person to ask.

behaviours.name: Award chaser, reads past papers
behaviours.how: Studies previous winning material, knows the formats cold, and buys anything that might give an edge.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Waits for a discount or a free trial, and will not pay full price for anything on the internet.

behaviours.name: Reads reviews and asks seniors first
behaviours.how: Checks whether anyone they know has used it and what they said before spending money.

objections: ChatGPT is free and it's already on my phone
299 is a lot of my pocket money
I don't trust AI facts in committee, the chair will catch me out
I only need this once, the night before the conference
My school coach already preps us for free
Why should I pay before I've seen if the output is any good?
I'll just ask a senior for their old position paper
Will my chair penalise me for AI-written work?
habits: your MUN club meets on Saturdays and the conference is three weeks away
you write your position paper at 11pm on your phone
you have ChatGPT open in another tab while you read this
your school already paid about 2500 rupees for your conference registration
you are in a WhatsApp group where seniors share their old papers and speeches

pitch:
MUN Prep — an AI preparation workspace for Model UN delegates.

Tell it your committee, your agenda and your country. It writes your research brief, your country's position, your position paper, your opening speech, your POIs and your draft resolution clauses.

Use it on your phone. Each brief takes about a minute.

₹199 for one week of access. ₹299 for one month. Paid by UPI.

There is no free trial and no free plan. You pay first, then use it.
